{{Documentation subpage}}

{{Lua|Module:Infobox|Module:InfoboxImage|Module:Check for unknown parameters}}
This template is used for UNESCO intangible heritage sites.

== Usage ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">
{{Infobox intangible heritage
|Name         = 
|Image        = 
|imagesize    = 
|alt          = 
|Caption      = 
|Country      = 
|ID           = 
|Region       = 
|Year         = 
|Session      = 
|List         = 
|Below        = 
|Note         = 
}}
</syntaxhighlight>

== Example ==
For example, the text to the left produces the infobox to the right ([[:en:Radif (music)|Radif (music)]]):
{{Infobox intangible heritage
| Image       = 
| Caption     =
| ICH         = The Radif of Iranian music
| State Party = Iran
| ID          = 00279
| Region      = APA
| Year        = 2009
| Session     = 4th
| List        = Representative
| Below       =
| Note        =
}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="wikitext">{{Infobox intangible heritage
| Image       = 
| Caption     =
| ICH         = The Radif of Iranian music
| State Party = Iran
| ID          = 00279
| Region      = APA
| Year        = 2009
| Session     = 4th
| List        = Representative
| Below       =
| Note        =
}}</syntaxhighlight>

*Image: Image related to list item
*Caption: Image caption
*ICH: Subject title
*State Party: Country which applied for the subject to be added the list
*ID: ######.
*Region: AFR, AST, APA, ENA, or LAC
*Year: Year the subject was added to the list
*Session: Session that year
*List: Representative, Need of Urgent Safeguarding, or Good Safeguarding Practices
*Below: For an extra image
*Note: An extra note, or image caption
